snippet.title: Sonic and the Duel of Fates - Announcement Trailer (Spotlight & Fan Fest)
snippet.description:
Introducing Sonic and the Duel of Fates - A new fangame made in RSDKv4 brought to you by a brand new team.
Join Sonic & Shadow as they face a new threat put upon the world.

This trailer was shown at the Sonic Hacking Spotlight, presented by https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIk4qsFXNJTDHsttiTuDwiQ
Along with the spotlight, it was shown off at Sonic Fan Fest 5.

Trailer and Thumbnail created by: ‪@Aly_Style 
Sonic voiced by: @TruBluHeroVA 
Sprite Artists (as seen in the trailer): Geoose, miniluv73, Nox, GPB, DecodedPixels, PKG
Sonic and Shadow Art: @TheNovaStar
Music: Sega Rally 2 - Unknown (it's literally called this)
